alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW04
title: Troubadour
description: "Sing... sing a song... sing it loud... sing it long..."

alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW 01
title: Age Ponders
description: I have no idea what he was thinking, but his expression made me stop and press the shutter. He appeared less than thrilled with the tourists below.

alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW10
title: I am King!
description: At an orphanage in Kenya, the children welcomed us with songs and a dance they had practiced just for our visit. This young leader proudly wore his handmade crown as he guided the performance. For that moment... he truly was king.

alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW09
title: Home Made...For You
description: We visited a local weaving shop where each scarf and shawl was made by hand on traditional looms. Watching the colors come together was as memorable as the finished pieces. Before long, most of us were taking home something that had been made just for us.

alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW08
title: Who Will Buy...
description: We were cruising the Nile when this boat pulled alongside. They started tossing clothes onto our boat for the Egyptian party we were having that night. If we liked them, we tossed back the money. Shopping on the Nile... definitely not your typical mall experience!

alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW07
title: So Little Means So Much!
description: We stopped at an orphanage in Kenya and brought gifts for the children. Someone handed this little boy a pair of Groucho glasses. He was so excited that he refused to take them off the entire time we were there. Sometimes the smallest gifts create the biggest smiles.

alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW 06
title: With Nothing-Fun!
description: A little bit of this... a little bit of that... and voilà... a bike! Built for work. Built for fun.

alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW 05
title: Volunteer for All
description: She works all day so all could play.

alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW03
title: Smile? Grin?
description: We were visiting a rug-weaving factory in Turkey while the tourists in our group debated which rug to buy. "I want that one... No, I want that one!" She seemed unsure whether to smile or grin at how silly the scene was!

alt: Photograph by Ed Shpritz
name: PW02
title: Tourists again?
description: Every time we drove by, children would smile, wave, and sometimes chase our vehicle. These two made me laugh. Their expressions made me think, "Tourists again?"
